newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway N.Sea output normal, no Statfjord loadings.
newsitem.headline: Norway N.Sea output normal, no Statfjord loadings.

text.p: Oil production at the North Sea Statfjord and Gullfaks oilfields was normal on Wednesday although bad weather was preventing loadings at Statfjord, Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said.
"Statfjord is not loading, they had to stop last night, but there is normal production because they have managed to load at all platforms since Monday," a Statoil spokeswoman said.
Offshore loadings and oil production were resumed at Statfjord, Gullfaks and associated fields late on Monday after bad weather over the weekend shut in all operations.
Statoil said it expected the weather to improve later on Wednesday.
